scope: Mains 4 FERA-to-FEMA statutory chronology primary-text check

primary_source.title: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (Act 42 of 1999)
primary_source.access: Direct official PDF text opened and read, not merely a search snippet

findings.claim: FEMA took effect in 1991 alongside liberalisation
findings.basis: Section 1 commencement footnote identifies 1 June 2000, notification G.S.R.371(E) dated 1 May 2000

recommended_student_wording: The 1991 liberalisation reforms preceded the later statutory transition from FERA 1973 to FEMA 1999, which commenced on 1 June 2000. Do not date FEMA's commencement to 1991.
limitations: Only the statutory transition component of Mains 4 was checked; original 1991 Industrial Policy, RBI exchange-rate chronology and sectoral employment claims remain unverified
